message: The other night, I was cooking dinner while my smoke alarm decided to throw a party. My wife chuckled and said, "Maybe we should have practiced our escape plan, huh?" I couldn't help but smile, thinking of all those times I insisted on checking the batteries and reviewing our plan. Sometimes, a little preparedness makes for the best family jokes! Just a gentle reminder to keep those smoke alarms in check—no one wants a surprise fire drill in the middle of taco night! 🌮
